additional_info.subject: ID0409211-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R1 170001443] Charging not possible CRM:00642002068
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
Hope you are doing great.
According to the issue reported by an end customer, the charging station displays an error message and charging processes are not possible. Upon checking the SCB backend, we found that the charger is offline. Please find the attached screenshot for your reference.
Unfortunately, we cannot do much remotely when we don't have SCB connection.
The best would be to have someone on site to check:
Local reboots help to bring the charger back online.
If the router is connected to internet
If the charger is powered
And kindly refer the below points which might be the reason to out the charger on SCB.
Then there might be Internet issue with the Siemens router and probably because of failover function the WAN is switched from Cellular to Ethernet.
I would recommend doing a Hard reset from "OCPP" (If charger is connected to OCPP server) or a local reboot will bring them up again.
data service of mobile network operator might not be available
- SIM card disabled / expired
- monthly data volume exhausted
- signal strength got weak due to changed radio transmission conditions
- in case of M2M contracts is IP not enabled
Backend related issues
- Backend changed the settings for the affected charger
- OCPP server on Backend side unavailable
Teltonika related issues
- Router switches to a wrong network service (e.g. 3G instead of 4G)
- Hardware failure of Router
- Router software crash
